peopleAlsoAsk: What does larb mean in Thai?
How are you supposed to eat larb?

items.markdown:
![Chicken Larb – Laab (Hmong/Thai/Lao) - Jasmine and Tea](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280435-1672-0139-0000-6d4103686ec0:6)
Larb (also spelled *laab* or *larp* ) is `a savory minced meat salad originating from Laos and the Isaan region of northeastern Thailand` . It features finely chopped or ground meat, fresh herbs, and a sharp citrus dressing.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/laab-moo/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/laab-moo/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Larb)[[3]](https://www.feastographyblog.com/blog/what-is-larb)[[4]](https://www.eatingthaifood.com/thai-larb-recipe/)[[5]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2ZTqlySDuzo&t=21)[[6]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/m3SxEEQlzGU)

Key Ingredients

- **Meat:** Minced pork, chicken, beef, or duck cooked or finely chopped.
- **Toasted Rice Powder (*khao khua*):** Uncooked sticky rice toasted until dark and ground into a nutty, crunchy powder.
- **Dressing:** Fresh lime juice and fish sauce mixed with chili flakes.
- **Herbs and Aromatics:** Mint leaves, cilantro, green onions, and thinly sliced shallots.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/laab-moo/) [[1]](https://thai-foodie.com/thaifood/recipe-for-the-perfect-thai-summer-salad-larb/)[[2]](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/larb)

How It Is Served

- **Accompaniments:** Eaten fresh with sticky rice and crisp raw vegetables like cabbage leaves, cucumbers, and long beans.
- **Flavor Profile:** A balance of sour, salty, spicy, and nutty tastes.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/laab-moo/)
